open_prs_at_review.head: 0fe00b18fef6b79a435817c99714f987329d5f3c
open_prs_at_review.body:
## Why
The Word source adapter explicitly refused `Font.AllCaps` because the live document model could not display native all-capital formatting. This adds that capability from source compilation through DOCX preservation, layout and existing editor workflows.

## Changes
- Compile Boolean `Font.AllCaps` on explicit paragraph/body and independent header/footer targets, including Font aliases, With blocks and named ByVal helpers.
- Import, inherit, copy and sparsely export native `w:caps`. True AllCaps/SmallCaps assignments clear the other mode; false changes only its own flag. Validate ambiguity and permissions before mutation.
- Display full-size Unicode capitals while preserving authored text, UTF-16 offsets, selection/caret behavior, clipboard contents, undo/redo and PDF logical text.
- Include capitalization in comparison, coalescing, Zotero transfer and proofing target guards. Preserve explicit CSL small-capital output over an AllCaps host.
- Add a runnable BAS, compiler/native/transaction/CLI/MCP/rendering/editor regression tests and VM/JavaScript receipt runner; update exact compatibility contracts.

## Intake and checkpoints
All 27 fork branches, 100 recent PR heads (#211–310) and four upstream heads present at the initial intake are already ancestors of baseline `01517de8`. No open PRs existed then. Incremental non-forced checkpoints remain on `codex/word-vba-formatting-20261121`; current frozen source is `0fe00b18fef6b79a435817c99714f987329d5f3c`.

Two independent branches appeared after that intake. Their captured checkpoints explicitly describe unfinished/unqualified work; they remain preserved for their own completion. Main will be refreshed again before publication.

## Local validation status
- Final editor gate: **259 passed across 17 files**, exit 0; no failures, skips or error events.
- All **23 changed Dart files** pass strict analysis and nonmutating formatting.
- Actual BAS: VM, optimized JavaScript compilation and Node all exit 0; complete decoded receipts and native part hashes match. Raw JSON differs only in ten display-scale numbers written as `1.0` versus `1`.
- **3,262 source inputs** remain unchanged for the accepted gates.
- Broad 271-file engine gate is still running. Existing stdio tests exceeded a 30-second source-startup timeout; full-file replay at the identical source with a 120-second timeout is in progress.
- This PR stays draft until local evidence and final intake are complete. GitHub Actions, CI checks and workflow queues are not queried or awaited.

## Scope
This remains the bounded write-only `vba-word` source adapter. No general COM runtime, embedded-project execution, numeric toggles, live property reads, locale-tailored casing, new ODT/RTF capitalization interchange or installed Word differential qualification is claimed.

# Word VBA AllCaps continuation — 21 November 2026

## Intake and scope

Work starts at `01517de8886ef7bd24947894be5dc823d0328869`, the remote
`main` merge of PR #310. The [initial intake](initial-intake.json) records all
27 pre-existing fork branches, the 100 recent PR heads (#211–#310), and four
upstream branches as ancestors of that baseline. There were no open PRs.
The new remote checkpoint branch is `codex/word-vba-formatting-20261121`.

The implementation adds the bounded Boolean `Font.AllCaps` setter through
the source adapter, native run formatting, DOCX import/export, layout and
editor model consumers. Capitalization is a display property; authored text
and source offsets stay intact. Setting AllCaps true clears SmallCaps, and
setting SmallCaps true clears AllCaps. False changes only the named flag.

The existing document-independent compiler, explicit paragraph/story
selectors, detached transaction, resource limits and opaque VBA-project
preservation remain the integration boundary. General Word automation,
property reads, numeric toggles and embedded VBA execution are outside this
increment.

## Checkpoint status

Initial intake and implementation checkpoints are saved. Source compilation,
native formatting, model import/export, Unicode display mapping, editor
regressions and CLI/MCP integration are implemented. Independent review found
and corrected an existing CSL small-capital interaction with inherited
AllCaps; plain spans keep host formatting and explicit small capitals clear
AllCaps sparsely. Targeted development checks pass. The complete source-bound
local gate is in progress; its commands, results and limits will follow here.

GitHub Actions, workflow runs and CI status queues are not queried or awaited.

## Primary contracts

- [Word Font.AllCaps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/word.font.allcaps)
- [Word Font.SmallCaps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/word.font.smallcaps)
- [WordprocessingML caps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.wordprocessing.caps)

The source dialect accepts actual Booleans, as for its existing font setters;
Microsoft's broader Long/toggle/read behavior is not claimed.

integration_risks: VBA modifies the same WordPropertyIo file as this Zotero increment. It adds native caps tracking/reset behavior and removes writeAllCapsOff together with updating the Word macro caller. The Zotero increment adds narrowly provenance-marked bCs/iCs/szCs and East Asian slot synchronization. Both behaviors must survive a normal merge.

VBA also changes WmlRunProps, WordDeserializer, WordSerializer, style cascade, layout, comparison, source editing, Zotero transfer and rich CSL run generation. A textually clean merge does not establish semantic compatibility with projected ODT script runs.

After VBA arrives in main, exercise ODT-to-DOCX script sizes/metadata, scalar bold/italic/size updates on projected runs, ordinary DOCX independent script slots, native AllCaps/SmallCaps resets and rich Zotero refresh before final publication.
The Mail branch includes persistent schema migration and UI changes; captured tests alone do not establish its unfinished work is accepted. German localization explicitly remains WIP.
recommended_sequence: Finish local qualification of the current isolated Zotero source; retain every initial intake proof and incremental remote checkpoint.
Leave the three captured unrelated active/draft/WIP branches on their own remote refs while their owners complete them. Do not report those heads as included in main.
At publication, read the latest refs once more. If main advances, fetch and merge it normally into the work branch, preserve both histories and inspect the actual overlap.
Rerun affected Word/Zotero/native-script tests after any VBA serialization/model reconciliation and the appropriate editor/open checks when incoming UI code changes the relevant surface.

Merge only the qualified Zotero branch into current main, then verify remote main ancestry/tree equality and document any still-active unrelated heads explicitly. Do not query or wait for GitHub Actions.
